title: Toughness Bounds for Fractional Hamiltonicity and Resistance Positivity
summary: A graph is fractionally Hamiltonian if it admits a nonnegative edge weighting in $[0,1]$ of total weight equal to its order such that every nontrivial edge cut has weight at least two. Motivated by Chvátal's Toughness Conjecture, Scheinerman and Ullman conjectured that every $2$-tough graph is fractionally Hamiltonian. In this paper, we show that every connected graph on at least three vertices that is not fractionally Hamiltonian has a non-Hamiltonian chordal spanning supergraph.
